description: This Java class 'DevicePropertyUtil' provides utility methods for retrieving and formatting device properties such as manufacturer, model, build version, and Android version from an IDevice object within the Android development tools.

classes.name: DevicePropertyUtil
classes.description: A utility class for accessing and formatting device properties such as manufacturer, model, build version, and Android version.

methods.name: fixManufacturerName
methods.description: Converts manufacturer name to uppercase if it is an acronym from a predefined set; otherwise, capitalizes each word.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Safely retrieves a property value from an IDevice, returning null if an exception occurs.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer name of the device, formatted appropriately, or a default value if unavailable.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the device model name with proper capitalization, or a default if unavailable.

methods.name: getBuild
methods.description: Constructs a string describing the device's Android build version and API level.

methods.name: getDeviceVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the AndroidVersion object representing the device's Android OS version, with fallback to default on error.
